title: Exact continuum-contact Dirichlet nonvanishing at an isolated degree-nine root
description: All positive moduli and all Dirichlet characters, excluding only the principal pole. Candidate.exact_contact_bound proves nonvanishing at the exact degree-nine continuum contact. Candidate.bound states the exact isolated polynomial-root endpoint; Candidate.bound_isolated proves existence and uniqueness, and Candidate.bound_le proves the certified rational comparison. The ranked fraction matches PR141. The proof uses finite positive-cost constructions and a final order argument, with no uniform-limit assumption on analytic constants. Extends Sil's admitted PR137 marked-anchor induction with a continuum supplier, averaged floor and complete variable-cost source/physical return. New work by Joseph Bebel, AI-assisted. Preserves source notices and credits Sil, OpenAI, Hailey Collet, ArviFoxy, Joe Richey, Jacob Sussman and other inherited contributors.
